column1: # The noise baseline of N9 (docs/design/compare.md, 9.4), first taken 2026-10-06 on the pairs of corpus/pairs.tsv. The
# figures are counts of characters and changes, so they do not depend on the machine. One row per set and class: the set
# (curated: the pairs of every pull request; full: every pair), the class, the pairs, the characters of the minimal diffs and
# of the redlines, the formatting changes, the pairs with exclusions, the p99 of red_chars / min_chars over the pairs whose
# minimal diff has 40 characters or more, and C, that p99 times 1.10 rounded up. The per-pair gate is
# red_chars <= C * min_chars + 40 and red_spans <= min_spans + 2, with C from the full row of the class (a curated row has
# the p99 and C of its own pairs, for information). A test never writes this file: the pair test prints the rows a run
# would make, and a change to the cleaning constants or the alignment floor re-takes them in the same commit.
